text:
If you're out and about today, this is the one to enjoy, sitting at 81 already with clear skies and nowhere close to the mugginess you might expect in August. The models are quibbling a bit over just how warm we get, but I'd bet on a high near 85, with that light west wind swinging around to the southeast by afternoon and staying under 10 mph the whole way. Air quality's good too, so no reason to keep the windows shut.

Tonight stays mostly clear and comfortable, dropping to near 63 with a light south breeze taking over. The lake's calm and inviting, waves a foot or less, water sitting at 75, so it's a fine evening to be out on the water or just by it. This tranquil stretch holds into Wednesday too, sunny and a couple degrees warmer near 87, before the pattern turns unsettled toward the weekend. Good waterfront evening straight through sunset around 8:15, no weather reason to head in early.
